title: LzPvP
description: A lightweight Japanese PvP practice server with FFA, duels, and party fights for Minecraft 1.21.1+
body:
# ✨ LzPvP | 1.21 PvP - β

**LzPvP** is a Japanese Minecraft 1.21 PvP practice server currently in development.

The server features multiple kits, FFA, duels, parties, low latency, and a custom lag-compensation system for smoother PvP practice.

## ⚔️ Features

- Free For All
- Duels
- Parties
- Multiple PvP kits
- Low-latency gameplay
- Custom ping-feel system for overseas-style PvP practice

## 🛠️ Development Support

We are looking for contributors and testers for:

- Bug reporting
- Map building
- PvP testing

## 🌸 IP

The server IP is available in our Discord server.
